articles.title: Barracuda Email Security Gateway Flaws Expose Devices to Potential Root-Level Compromise
articles.summary:
Barracuda has released security patches for two vulnerabilities that could be exploited to bypass authorization controls and gain root access to affected Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliances. These vulnerabilities, identified as CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560, require attackers to access the device’s administrative interface. articles.title: Critical SolarWinds Dameware Vulnerability Enables Attackers to Take Control of Remote Systems
articles.summary:
